theme_and_archetype.description: Girly, soft pastel theme with blush pink, lavender, cream, and gold accents. Elegant, premium, Instagram-inspired UI.

motion.floating_elements: Framer motion { y: [0, -15, 0], rotate: [-5, 5, -5] } with repeat Infinity, duration 4-6s
motion.page_transitions: Fade in, slide up 20px on mount

components.navbar: Sticky, top-0, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, border-b border-white/40
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#F8C8DC] text-[#4A3B32] hover:bg-[#F2B8D0] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium transition-all shadow-soft. Secondary: border-2 border-[#F8C8DC] text-[#4A3B32] rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#FDFBF7]
components.cards: bg-white rounded-[32px] p-6 shadow-soft hover:shadow-hover transition-all duration-300 border border-[#F2E8E3]
components.ai_chat: Floating FAB bottom-right, hover to reveal small welcome message, click to open chat interface
components.gallery: Masonry grid with group-hover image scale and overlay, Instagram icon appearing on hover

media.icons_library: lucide-react for standard UI, custom SVGs for decorative sparkles and hearts

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion heavily for smooth entrance animations on scroll and floating aesthetic elements.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Must use 'Playfair Display' or similar serif for luxury feel.
Implement the AI chat as a subtle floating button that opens a tailored Shadcn popover/dialog on click, with hover tooltip.
Navbar must be sticky with backdrop-blur and semi-transparent white background, hiding border unless scrolled.
Products need a clean Add to Cart interaction, preferably with a toast notification (Sonner).
Gallery should mimic an Instagram grid layout, using the media.gallery images provided, maintaining aspect ratios.
Ensure the hero section implements the soft pastel gradient and absolute positioned floating elements (macarons/cakes) for the dreamy vibe.
Custom Order form should have file upload (Shadcn input type file) and select components for themes.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
